title: Cute!
text: Cute!. This cookie jar arrived just as I had decided to start dieting again. So I won't be filling it with cookies anytime soon. I did decide to put our breakfast cookie packages in it for the time being.I'm also keeping it in the pantry. However, I'm sure it will make its way to the kitchen counter soon! My diets don't usually last very long!  The jar is really cute! It's light weight, but seems to be sturdy enough. I love the Rae Dunn lettering and I'm very happy to have this.

product_metadata.title: Rae Dunn Clear Glass Cookie Jar, Kitchen Canister with Lid, Hand-Lettered Snack Jar
features: STYLISH GLASS JAR WITH LID: This adorable storage container makes grabbing your next treat easy. It is made of clear glass and has an airtight acacia wood lid. Cookies have never looked so sweet!

CUTE, FUNCTIONAL PANTRY STORAGE: This large glass container tells you exactly what it’s for in cute hand-lettered style, but it can also be used for dog treats or candy (but don’t get them confused!).
CLASSIC GLASS CONTAINER FOR ANY DECOR: Whether your style is farmhouse rustic or quirky modern, the hand-lettered look of this whimsical glass canister will look great on any countertop.
UNIQUE KITCHEN GIFT: Perfect for a home cook or as a housewarming present, this useful, timeless piece will fit right into any kitchen collection and be appreciated and loved by all.
FALL IN LOVE WITH YOUR HOME: Rae Dunn’s collection of handcrafted kitchen products seamlessly balances function and design with a touch of whimsy and fun. Add to your collection today!
